title: Agreeable Allays
description: Transforms allays into loyal companions that roam by your side, deliver items to your inventory, and never block your view.
body:
# Agreeable Allays

Allays deserve better. Instead of chaotic item-throwing gnats that fly into your face and forget you the moment you take their item back, **Agreeable Allays** turns them into loyal companions — like a Pokémon at your side.

## Features

### Companion Positioning
Bonded allays roam in a natural sphere behind and around you — visible in your peripheral vision but never blocking your view. They avoid your forward field of view and smoothly arc out of the way when you turn toward them. Multiple allays spread out naturally, each with unique movement patterns.

### Direct Inventory Delivery
No more items thrown at your face. When your allay returns with collected items, it silently slots them into your inventory. If your inventory is full, items drop on the ground like normal.

### Item Swap
Right-click a bonded allay with a new item to swap — the allay takes the new item and returns the old one to your inventory. No need to take and re-give.

### Graceful Detach
Taking an allay's item no longer causes instant abandonment. The allay lingers for 10 seconds, giving you time to give it a new item and re-bond. After 10 seconds, it becomes wild again.

### Sit / Stay
Shift-right-click a companion allay to toggle sit/stay. A sitting allay stays put and passively collects matching items that land nearby — a little collection bin with wings. Persists across logout/login.

### Interested Behavior
Shift + look directly at your allay to call it to you. It flies to a position in front of your eyes and faces you, ready for interaction. Just look away to release it back to companion roaming.

### Teleportation
If you get more than 64 blocks away, your allay teleports to your side instead of forgetting you. No more losing allays to distance.

### Zero Collision
Allays have no collision with players — they can't push you or block your movement. Walk right through them.

### Fire Immunity
Bonded allays are immune to fire and lava damage. No more losing your companion to a stray lava pool.

### Idle Dancing
Allays occasionally dance while following you or sitting — short, infrequent bursts that give them personality.

### Note Block Delivery
Vanilla note block redirection is preserved. Allays still deliver to note blocks when activated — useful for automation builds.

## Interactions

| Action | Target | Result |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Right-click with item | Wild allay | Bond as companion |
| Right-click empty hand | Companion | Take item, 10s detach begins |
| Right-click with item | Companion | Swap items |
| Shift + right-click | Companion | Toggle sit/stay |
| Shift + look at | Any bonded allay | Call to you (Interested) |

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader 0.15.0+
- Fabric API
- [MenuKit](https://modrinth.com/mod/menukit)
